leadText: (Japanese: ＢＯＸ脱出サバイバル Box Escape Survival) is the 23rd chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.
plainText:
(Japanese: ＢＯＸ脱出サバイバル Box Escape Survival) is the 23rd chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
The second round of BHS "Box Escape Survival" continues, as Carola is the next to escape her box, followed by one person from each of the other boxes except Ryouga's.
Karuta explains to Ryouga that he cannot lose because he needs the prize money from BHS to buy medicine to cure his sick village, and as time is running out, attacks Ryouga.
Ryouga easily defeats Karuta, but tells him they'll find a way to escape together no matter what, and after Ryouga figures out the trick to the buttons, they do.
Pauline leads the nine remaining contestants out into a mountainous area and declares it "Count to Ten Survival".
